summary: Full backend + frontend testing of FairBench MVP. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (CRUD, run mock, Reweighing×MLP skip, pareto, regression, 404s). Frontend: full 7-step wizard walkthrough via Playwright succeeded — dashboard, dataset selection, constraint tooltips (Reweighing disabled with MLP; Regression disabled when non-'No Method' fairness), all step navigation, script dialog + copy, run dialog with 4 stages, results page (best card, chart, metrics table, sort toggles), delete card, mocked download toasts.
critical_code_review_comments: Step 4 (Step4Fairness.jsx line 16): toggleAll auto-selects 'No Method' when the fairness toggle is turned ON with no methods selected. This is intended, but combined with the Label click semantics can cause 'No Method' to toggle OFF if the user clicks it when it was already pre-selected. Consider making 'No Method' non-deselectable or reflecting default selection visually so users don't accidentally deselect it.

server.py: When fairness_enabled is False, list summary returns method_count=0 but downstream 'No Method' fallback (line 258) still uses 1 combo per model. Consider surfacing method_count=1 in the summary for consistency, or documenting.
server.py: /api/experiments returns all 500 max via to_list(500). Consider pagination when scaling; acceptable for MVP.

ResultsPage.jsx: chartData uses only the first fairness metric name (fairness_metrics[0]?.name) for the pareto scatter's fairness_gap axis — if no fairness metrics selected the axis reads 0 for all points. Acceptable for MVP but worth noting.

WizardPage.jsx buildConfigForApi does not strip preview from dataset before POST (dataset.preview is not sent because ExperimentConfig.dataset does not include a preview field — Pydantic ignores extras via config). Confirmed extra='ignore' on Experiment; DatasetConfig does not set it explicitly but Pydantic default drops unknowns.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed experiments and clean them up. Left 'Test Run' curl seed intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/. Uses pytest-xdist which runs cleanup test in parallel with create tests; cleanup was still successful because at least one create completes before cleanup runs, and orphaned TEST_ experiments were removed manually via curl. Consider adding a proper session-scoped teardown fixture if flakiness arises. Playwright note: `page.click('[data-testid=fairness-method-No-Method]')` toggles the already-preselected 'No Method' OFF — click DIR/other methods first, or explicitly re-check state.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found. One test-script false alarm on combo count (expected 4, got 2) traced to unintended toggle-off of 'No Method' in Step 4 due to it being pre-selected on fairness enable. Not a product bug.
